description: Show the signed-in account's plan name, links used this month, editable credits remaining, scans versus the included allowance, and which features are unlocked (including analytics depth, custom slugs, bulk create, and Bitly import). Use this before create_dynamic_qr, bulk_create_dynamic_qrs, or import_bitly_csv to check credits and plan gates, or when the user asks what plan they are on or what is left this month. Do not use this for scan totals (get_account_analytics) or to change the plan; `plansUrl` is the URL to send the user to if they want to upgrade. No input parameters.
name: get_plan
title: My plan
